The Universal Feed Size


Need the safest cross-platform image size for 2026? Use 1080 x 1080 px (1:1 ratio). This dimension displays perfectly as a standard feed post across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky and Threads without automatic cropping.


Every social media platform has its own image specs. Get them wrong and the visuals behind your[social media content strategy](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-content-strategy/) show up blurry and cropped. This guide gives you the exact social media image sizes and post sizes for every major platform in 2026.


Your[visual identity](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/brand-identity/) is often the first interaction a potential customer has with your brand. A strong visual strategy makes that first impression count and getting your dimensions right is where it starts.


The right tools make resizing images across platforms fast. Use[Landscape](https://sproutsocial.com/landscape/) , Sprout Social’s free image resizing tool, to resize a single image for all social media sizes at once.


Before you dive in, bookmark these resources:


- **Our**[social media video specs and ad guide](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-video-specs-guide/)
- **Ready-to-use assets:**[Free social media images, already optimized](https://sproutsocial.com/templates/)
- **Platform support details:**[Sprout Social-supported files and sizes in our Help Center](https://support.sproutsocial.com/hc/en-us/articles/49485764377229-Image-Requirements-per-Network-with-Sprout-Publishing)


## Why do social media image sizes matter?


Social media image sizes are the pixel dimensions, aspect ratios and file limits each platform uses to display profile photos, cover images and posts. Match them and your visuals stay sharp and uncropped.


Miss them and the platform makes the call for you. Wrong sizes signal to your audience that your brand doesn’t sweat the details. Here’s what happens:


- **Cropping:** The platform trims logos and text at the edges
- **Compression:** Fine detail turns soft and blurry
- **Letterboxing:** Mismatched ratios leave empty space around your image
- **Rejection:** Some uploads fail outright


Scheduling tools publish through platform APIs, which enforce stricter limits than the apps. Instagram’s API, for example, accepts feed images between 4:5 and 1.91:1 and nothing outside that range.


Data from our[2025 Content Benchmarks Report](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/data/content-benchmarks/) shows images account for 48% of all brand content on Facebook. Static images are still the workhorse format, so sizing them right protects most of your output and preserves your brand identity.


## Social media image sizes cheat sheet


This cheat sheet gives you the essential social media image sizes for every major platform at a glance, with profile image, cover image and primary post image all in one place.


These are the baseline specs for 2026. Publishing the wrong size means blurry visuals and automatic cropping.


**Platform** **Profile image** **Cover image** **Primary post image**


**Instagram** 110×110 px N/A 1080×1080 px or 1080×1350 px


**Facebook** 320×320 px 851×315 px 1080×1350 px


**X (formerly known as Twitter)** 400×400 px 1500×500 px 1600×900 px


**LinkedIn** 400×400 px 4200×700 px 1200×627 px


**TikTok** 200×200 px N/A 1080×1920 px


**YouTube** 800×800 px 2560×1440 px 1280×720 px


**Pinterest** 165×165 px 800×450 px 735×1102 px


**Snapchat** 320×320 px 375×569 px 1080×1920 px


**Threads** 320×320 px N/A 1080×1080 px


**Bluesky** 400×400 px 1500×1500 px 1080×1080 px


**Google My Business** 720×720 px 1024×576 px 1200×900 px


Each platform has additional format requirements, including Stories, Reels, banners and more, which are covered in the full sections below cover.


### What image size works on every platform?


One 1080-pixel-wide image covers most feeds. Pick the ratio that fits the placement:


- **1080 x 1080 pixels (1:1):** Works across Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Threads and Bluesky feeds
- **1080 x 1350 pixels (4:5):** Wins more vertical space in mobile feeds
- **1080 x 1920 pixels (9:16):** Covers Stories, Reels, TikTok photo mode, Snapchat and YouTube Shorts
- **1000 x 1500 pixels (2:3):** Pinterest’s recommended size and the one exception to the 1080-pixel rule


Use JPG for photos to keep files small and PNG for graphics with text, logos or sharp edges. Upload the highest-quality file within each platform’s limit and let the platform do the compressing. Keep key text and logos away from the edges so circular crops and UI overlays don’t hide them.


## Facebook image sizes


Facebook remains one of the[most widely used social media platforms](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-stats-for-marketers/) for brand content. Getting your social media image dimensions right ensures your visuals display crisp and professional across every device and placement.


Desktop and mobile render images differently, so choose dimensions based on where your audience primarily views your content.


Learn more about Facebook image sizes


Get specs and tips for implementing the best visual content on Facebook with these guides:


- [Always up-to-date list of Facebook ad sizes and specs](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-ad-sizes/)
- [The picture-perfect Facebook cover photo size](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-cover-photo-size/)
- [Facebook event photo size and dimensions guide](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-event-cover-photos/)
- [Sprout Social-supported files and sizes in our Help Center](https://support.sproutsocial.com/hc/en-us/articles/49485764377229-Image-Requirements-per-Network-with-Sprout-Publishing)


### Facebook personal and Business page profile picture sizes


Your personal or[Business Page](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/how-to-use-facebook/) profile image is your first impression on Facebook. It appears on your timeline layered over your cover photo and shows up whenever you post, comment or appear in search results.


**Facebook profile picture image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 320×320 pixels
- **Minimum file size:** 180×60 pixels
- **Displays:**


- 176×176 pixels (desktop)
- 196×196 pixels (smartphones)
- 36×36 pixels (most feature phones)


- **Recommended file type:** JPG, PNG
- Profile pictures are **cropped to a circle**


### Facebook profile and Business Page cover photo sizes


Your[Facebook cover photo](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-cover-photo-size/) only appears on your Facebook profile page, and it stretches across the entire screen, giving you more freedom to choose something creative or supplement your profile picture. Use this space to post something that speaks more toward you as an individual or highlight a brand campaign.


**Facebook Business Page cover photo image guidelines**


- **Aspect ratio:**


- 16:9 (on desktop)
- 2.4:1 (on mobile)


- **Minimum required size:** 400×150 pixels
- **Recommended image size:** 851×315 pixels
- **Mobile display size:** 640×360 pixels
- **Max file size:** 100kb
- **Recommended file type:** JPG, PNG


**Facebook personal profile cover photo image guidelines**


- **Aspect ratio:**


- 16:9 (on desktop)
- 2.4:1 (on mobile)


- **Minimum required size:** 720 pixels wide
- **Max file size:** 100kb
- **Recommended file type:** JPG, PNG


Pro-Tip:


The left side of your cover photo will be covered by your profile picture. On mobile, up to 75% of your profile picture will overlap into the cover photo. Plan your text placement accordingly!


### Facebook timeline image post sizes


Shared images appear on your timeline and in followers’ News Feeds. The[Facebook algorithm](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-algorithm/) determines reach, so posts that drive engagement get distributed further—to your followers and beyond. When looking at standard social media post sizes, shared images are critical for engagement.


**Facebook shared** **timeline** **image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:**


- Square images: 1080×1080 pixels (1:1 aspect ratio)
- Vertical images: 1440×1800 pixels (4:5 aspect ratio)


- **Maximum file size:** 30MB
- **Recommended file type:** JPG, PNG


**Learn more about supported Facebook files and sizes in our Help Center guide on[Sprout Social’s Publishing Requirements](https://support.sproutsocial.com/hc/en-us/articles/49485764377229-Image-Requirements-per-Network-with-Sprout-Publishing) .**


### Facebook Stories image sizes


[Facebook Stories](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-stories/) run full-screen and vertical, and they sit at the top of the app where your audience sees them first.


**Facebook Stories image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 1080×1920 pixels
- **Minimum width:** 500 pixels
- **Aspect ratio:** 9:16 and 4:5 to 1.91:1
- **Safe zone:** Keep text and logos out of the top and bottom 14% (about 250 pixels) so profile icons and reply bars don’t cover them
- **Recommended file type:** JPG or PNG


### Facebook Feed ad image sizes


Facebook Feed ads appear natively alongside posts from a user’s friends, family and followed Pages. This placement is ideal for capturing attention as users scroll through their daily updates.


Looking for Facebook ad sizes?


Facebook ad formatting can be even more complex than organic posts, so for more guidelines, check out our[complete guide to every Facebook ad size](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/facebook-ad-sizes/) !


**Facebook Feed ad image specs**


- **Recommended ratio:** 1:1 or 4:5
- **Recommended resolution:**


- **1:1 ratio:** 1080×1080 pixels
- **4:5 ratio:** 1440×1800 pixels


- **Maximum file size:** 30MB
- **Recommended image formats:** JPG, PNG


### Facebook Story ad image sizes


Facebook Stories ads are full-screen, vertical ads that appear between organic Stories. This immersive, ephemeral format is perfect for grabbing user attention with visually compelling content.


**Facebook Stories ad image specs**


- **Recommended resolution:** 1440×2560 pixels
- **Recommended ratio:** 9:16
- **Minimum width:** 500 pixels
- **Maximum file size:** 30MB
- **Recommended image formats:** JPG, PNG


Find more information on the image sizes for Facebook, visit the[Facebook Help Center](https://www.facebook.com/help/216476848433351) .


## Instagram organic image sizes


Instagram organic image sizes determine how your content displays across the feed, Stories, Reels and profile grid. Use the correct dimensions for each format to avoid cropping, compression artifacts and missed impressions.


### Instagram profile picture


Your Instagram profile picture is the first visual identifier users see in search, the Explore tab and comment threads. Keep it recognizable at small sizes; a clean logo or tight headshot works best.


**Instagram profile picture guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 320×320 pixels
- **Recommended aspect ratio:** 1:1


### Instagram feed and carousel image sizes


Feed and[carousel posts](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-carousel/) are the foundation of your Instagram presence. Instagram now supports the native 3:4 aspect ratio that most phone cameras capture by default, displaying images at their native size rather than stretching them to fit.


Whether you publish natively in the app, via desktop or through a[social media management tool](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-management-tools/) , these social media post sizes keep your visuals sharp and properly framed. Learn how to[post on Instagram](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/how-to-post-on-instagram/) effectively once you’ve sized your images.


**Instagram feed and carousel image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 1080×1080 pixels or 1080×1350 pixels


- Square images: 1080×1080 pixels (1:1 aspect ratio)
- Vertical images: 1080×1350 pixels (4:5 or 3:4 aspect ratio)


- **Recommended aspect ratio:** 1:1 or 4:5
- **Grid view size:** 1012×1350 pixels (grid view always displays at 3:4)
- **Maximum file size:** 30MB
- **Recommended file type:** JPG, PNG and HEIC/HEIF
- **Maximum images** **or videos** **per carousel post:** 20


**Learn more about supported Instagram files and sizes in our Help Center guide on[Sprout Social’s Publishing Requirements](https://support.sproutsocial.com/hc/en-us/articles/49485764377229-Image-Requirements-per-Network-with-Sprout-Publishing) .**


### Instagram grid thumbnails sizes


Thumbnails are the grid-view renditions of every post on your profile. They display at a fixed size and expand when tapped, so your key visual elements need to read clearly at a small scale.


**Instagram** **grid** **thumbnail guidelines**


- **Profile grid thumbnail size:** 1080×1440 pixels
- **On-screen** **display size:** 161×201 pixels
- **Recommended image width:** 1080 pixels
- **Feed aspect ratio:** 3:4


### Instagram Reels image sizes


[Instagram Reels](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-reels/) are the platform’s primary discovery engine. The cover image appears in the Reels tab and on your profile grid. It’s the first frame that drives a tap, so treat it with the same care as a campaign hero image.


**Instagram Reels cover image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 1080×1920 pixels
- **Recommended aspect ratio:** 9:16 (grid view always displays at 3:4)
- **Grid view size:** 1080×1440 pixels
- **Note:** You can edit cover photos after upload.


Pro tip:


Leave 14% (250 pixels) at the top and 20% (340 pixels) of the bottom of your creative free of text and logos. This “safe zone” ensures your key elements aren’t covered by the profile icon or call-to-action prompts.


### Instagram Stories image sizes


[Instagram Stories](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-stories/) support both images and videos in a full-screen vertical format. Build a deliberate Stories strategy because the format drives direct engagement and keeps your brand visible between feed posts.


**Instagram Story image guidelines**


- **Recommended resolution:** 1080×1920 pixels
- **Safe area (text and interactive elements):** 1080×1610 pixels
- **Aspect ratio:** 9:16
- **Recommended file type:** JPG, PNG and HEIC/HEIF


### Instagram feed image ad sizes


Instagram Feed ads blend into the user’s primary browsing experience, appearing as they scroll through photos and videos from accounts they follow.


For those looking for more info on[Instagram ad sizes](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/instagram-ad-sizes/) , including video specs, check out this guide!


**Instagram Feed ad image specs**


- **Minimum resolution:** 1080×1080 pixels
- **Recommended ratio:**


- **Square aspect ratio:** 1:1
- **Vertical aspect ratio:** 4:5


- **Supported aspect ratios in feed:**


- **Maximum aspect ratio:** 1.91:1
- **Minimum aspect ratio:** 9:16 (although will be cropped to 4:5)


- **Minimum width:** 1080 pixels
- **Maximum file size:** 30MB
- **Recommended image formats:** JPG, PNG
- **Note on captions:** While you can include a URL in your feed ad caption (up to 63,000 characters), it will not be clickable. To drive traffic to a website, you should use the designated call-to-action button (like “Learn More” or “Shop Now”) provided in the ad setup.


### Instagram Story image ad sizes


Instagram Story ads are full-screen, vertical ads that appear between users’ organic Stories. This engaging format suits temporary, interactive content that captures immediate attention.


**Instagram Stories ad image specs**


- **Recommended resolution:** 1080×1920 pixels
- **Recommended ratio:** 9:16
- **Minimum width:** 500 pixels
- **Maximum file size:** 30MB
- **Recommended image formats:** JPG, PNG
- **Pro-tip for Stories Ads:** Leave about 14% (roughly 250 pixels) at the top and bottom of the image free from text, logos, or other key creative elements. This “safe area” ensures your content isn’t covered by the profile icon or the call-to-action button at the bottom.


## LinkedIn image sizes


LinkedIn is the[world’s largest professional social media platform](https://news.linkedin.com/about-us) with more than 1.3 billion members. Getting your LinkedIn image sizes right means your brand shows up polished and credible, whether someone lands on your personal profile, company page or a sponsored post in their feed.


### LinkedIn personal profile image sizes


Your profile image is the first thing people see when they visit your LinkedIn page. Use a high-quality, well-cropped headshot that represents you clearly at small sizes.


**LinkedIn personal profile image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 400×400 pixels
- **Minimum image size:** 268×268 pixels
- **Maximum file size:** 3MB
- **Recommended file type:** JPG or PNG


### LinkedIn personal profile cover image sizes


Your personal cover image is prime real estate for communicating your professional brand. Choose an image that complements your profile photo and reinforces your expertise at a glance.


**LinkedIn cover image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 1584×396 pixels
- **Maximum file size:** 8MB
- **Recommended file type:** JPG or PNG


### LinkedIn company logo image sizes


Your company logo appears next to your brand name on your LinkedIn homepage and in the “Companies you may want to follow” section. A sharp, correctly sized logo builds instant recognition and drives follower growth.


**LinkedIn company logo image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 400×400 pixels
- **Minimum image size:** 268×268 pixels
- **Maximum file size:** 3MB
- **Recommended file type:** JPG or PNG


### LinkedIn company cover image sizes


The company cover image spans the full top of your LinkedIn page, giving your brand significantly more visual space than a personal profile. Use it to communicate your brand story, a campaign or a key value proposition.


**LinkedIn company cover image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 1512×256 pixels
- **Minimum image size:** 1512×256 pixels
- **Maximum file size:** 3MB
- **Recommended file type:** JPG or PNG


### LinkedIn Life (Career) tab


The Life tab gives your company page a human dimension by showcasing culture, employee experience and day-to-day life at your organization. It features a hero image at the top and a horizontal scrolling gallery of company photos below.


**LinkedIn Life tab image guidelines**


- **Recommended size for** **Life** **main image:** 1128×376 pixels
- **Recommended size for** **Life** **company photos:** 900×600 pixels


- **Minimum image size for Life company photos:** 265×176 pixels


- **Recommended size for** **Life** **custom modules:** 502×282 pixels
- **Recommended file type:** JPG or PNG
- The **Life tab** only appears if you’ve enhanced your LinkedIn Pages with Career Pages. The dynamic cover image slideshow is available with a Premium Company Page subscription.


Find more information in the[LinkedIn Help Center](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/70781/image-specifications-for-your-linkedin-pages-and-career-pages?lang=en) .


### LinkedIn post specs with a shared image or link


These are the baseline social media post sizes to use when testing a LinkedIn post with a photo or a link with a preview image.


**LinkedIn shared image post spec** **or shared link image** **guidelines**


- **Recommended size for square images:** 1080×1080 pixels (1:1 aspect ratio)
- **Recommended size for landscape images:** 1200×627 pixels (1.9:1 aspect ratio)


- **Recommended file type:** JPG or PNG
- **Character limit:** 3,000 characters


**Learn more about supported LinkedIn files and sizes in our Help Center guide on[Sprout Social’s Publishing Requirements](https://support.sproutsocial.com/hc/en-us/articles/49485764377229-Image-Requirements-per-Network-with-Sprout-Publishing) .**


### LinkedIn carousel image ad sizes


LinkedIn carousel ads let viewers swipe through up to 10 slides, with each image supporting an individual link. They work well for storytelling and driving clicks across multiple offers or messages.


**LinkedIn carousel ad guidelines**


- **Recommended image resolution size:** 1080×1080 pixels
- **Recommended image aspect ratio:** 1:1
- **Recommended file size:** 10MB
- **Recommended image type** : JPG or PNG
- **Number of carousel cards:** 2–10


## Pinterest image sizes


Pinterest is a visual search engine, and tall, vertical Pins earn the most feed space. Size your Pins to Pinterest’s 2:3 ratio so feeds don’t cut them off.


### Pinterest profile picture size


Your Pinterest profile picture is the first visual impression your brand makes. Upload a square image as large as possible and Pinterest resizes it for you. Choose an image that’s immediately recognizable and tied directly to your brand identity.


**Pinterest profile picture image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 280×280 pixels
- **Image display size:** 165×165 pixels (cropped into a circle)
- **Maximum file size:** 10MB
- **Recommended image types:** JPG and PNG


### Pinterest cover image size


Your Pinterest cover image sits at the top of your profile page and sets the visual tone for your brand. It offers valuable space to showcase your products, highlight key campaigns or reinforce your brand identity to profile visitors. Choosing a high-quality visual with the right aspect ratio ensures your profile looks polished across all devices.


**Pinterest cover image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 800×450 pixels
- **Recommended aspect ratio:** 16:9
- **Recommended image types:** JPG and PNG


### Pinterest image Pin sizes


**Pinterest gives tall images room to stand out** , up to a point.[Pinterest recommends](https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/pinterest-product-specs) a 2:3 ratio at 1000 x 1500 pixels. Pins taller than 2:3 risk getting cut off in feeds, so build every Pin to that ratio.


**Pinterest Pin image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 1000×1500 pixels
- **Recommended ratio:** 2:3
- **Maximum file size:** 20MB (from web); 1GB (from mobile)
- **Supported file types:** BMP, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WEBP


**Text guidelines**


- **Title character count:** 100 characters max
- **Textbox** **character count:** 250 characters max
- **Description character count:** 800 characters max


**Learn more about supported Pinterest files and sizes in our Help Center guide on[Sprout Social’s Publishing Requirements](https://support.sproutsocial.com/hc/en-us/articles/49485764377229-Image-Requirements-per-Network-with-Sprout-Publishing) .**


### Pinterest standard image ad sizes


These are standard ads that feature only one image.


**Pinterest single ad image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 1000×1500 pixels
- **Recommended ratio:** 2:3
- **Maximum file size:** 20MB (from desktop); 32MB (from mobile)
- **Supported file types:** JPEG, PNG


**Text guidelines**


- **Title character count:** 100 characters max
- **Description character count:** 800 characters max


### Pinterest standard image ad sizes


Pinterest carousel ads feature multiple images for people to swipe through. This feature is only available for Pinterest business accounts.


**Pinterest carousel ad image guidelines**


- **Recommended ratio:** 1:1 or 2:3
- **Maximum file size:** 20MB per image
- **Carousel image quantity:** 2 to 5 per carousel
- **Supported file types:** JPEG, PNG


**Text guidelines**


- **Title character count:** 100 characters max
- **Description character count:** 800 characters max


## Snapchat image sizes


Snapchat is built for vertical creative. Images that aren’t sized for full-screen viewing lose impact immediately.


### Snapchat profile picture size


Your Snapchat profile picture displays as a circle across the app. Size your image at **320 x 320 pixels** to keep your logo or visual sharp and centered within that circular frame.


**Snapchat profile image guidelines**


- **Recommended resolution:** 320×320 pixels
- **Recommended ratio:** 1:1
- **Maximum file size:** 2MB
- **Supported file types:** JPEG, PNG


### Snapchat Story image and single image ad sizes


Stories and image ads on Snapchat require a full-screen vertical format. Use these dimensions to keep your creative polished and on-brand.


**Snapchat Story image or single image ad guidelines**


- **Recommended size:** 720×1280 pixels
- **Aspect ratio:** 9:16
- **File formats:** JPG or PNG


Snapchat’s interface overlays navigation elements at the top and bottom of every screen. Place your logo, calls to action and key visuals inside the[safe zone](https://businesshelp.snapchat.com/s/article/safe-zones?language=en_US) so nothing important disappears behind the UI.


## TikTok image sizes


TikTok’s visual identity starts with your profile image, and getting the specs right ensures your brand shows up sharp across every device. Every image placement on TikTok is a first impression that earns the followers.


Need TikTok video specs too? The[always-up-to-date video specs guide](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-video-specs-guide/#tiktok) has everything you need.


### TikTok profile image size


Your TikTok profile image is prime real estate for brand recognition. Use it to reinforce your visual identity or spotlight a campaign instead of just filling a placeholder.


**TikTok profile image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 200×200 pixels
- **Minimum image size:** 20×20 pixels
- **Recommended file types:** JPG, GIF or PNG


### TikTok photo mode and carousel image sizes


TikTok’s photo mode, also called carousel posts, lets you share a sequence of still images in a single post. The format invites swiping and displays at a full-screen vertical ratio. Use the same vertical dimensions as your video content to keep your creative consistent across formats.


**TikTok photo mode image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 1080×1920 pixels
- **Recommended aspect ratio:** 9:16 (vertical)
- **Minimum image size:** 360×360 pixels
- **Recommended file types:** JPG or PNG
- **Additional supported ratios:** Square (1:1) and Landscape (16:9) but vertical (9:16) performs strongest on mobile


**Learn more about supported TikTok files and sizes in our Help Center guide on[Sprout Social’s Publishing Requirements](https://support.sproutsocial.com/hc/en-us/articles/49485764377229-Image-Requirements-per-Network-with-Sprout-Publishing) .**


### TikTok Ad profile photo ad size


Your profile picture appears alongside your ad. For Spark Ads, TikTok automatically uses the video account’s existing profile photo. For Non-Spark Ads, a default profile picture will be used if you leave this space blank.


**TikTok Ad profile photo guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 98×98 pixels
- **Recommended aspect ratio:** 1:1
- **Maximum file size:** 50 KB
- **Recommended file type:** JPG, JPEG or PNG
- **Safe zone:** Keep your key visual element in the center of a 66 x 66 pixel area to prevent it from being cropped out by the circular display.


### TikTok Ad account name (Nickname) ad size


Your account name helps users identify your brand as they scroll.


**TikTok Ad account name guidelines**


- **Character limits:** Displays only one line with a maximum of 20 characters in most languages
- **App Names:** Automatically extracted from the App Store or Google Play.
- **Landing Pages:** The account name will be automatically used as the landing page heading on the in-app browser.


### TikTok Carousel ad image sizes


Carousel Ads allow you to showcase a series of images in a single ad unit. Depending on whether you use a Standard Carousel or a Video Shopping Ad (VSA) Carousel, the image volume requirements differ.


**Standard Carousel ad image guidelines**


- **Recommended file type:** JPG, JPEG or PNG
- **Recommended file size:** 100 KB or less
- **Image volume:** Minimum of 2 images; maximum of 35 images
- **Image resolutions:**


- **Horizontal:** 1200×628 pixels
- **Square:** 640×640 pixels
- **Vertical:** 720×1280 pixels


**VSA (Value Exchange Suggest Algorithm) Carousel ad image guidelines**


- **Recommended file type:** JPG, JPEG or PNG
- **Recommended file size:** 100 KB or less
- **Image volume:** Minimum of 2 images shown; maximum of 20 images shown
- **Image resolutions:**


- **Horizontal:** 1200×628 pixels
- **Square:** 640×640 pixels
- **Vertical:** 720×1280 pixels


## Threads image sizes


Threads rewards simple visuals that feel native to the feed. The right image size keeps your post clean, readable and ready to travel across mobile screens.


### Threads profile picture size


When you set up Threads, you can import your Instagram profile picture or upload a different one. For full specs, see the Instagram section above. Your picture displays as a circle in the Threads feed, so center your subject.


**Threads profile image guidelines**


- **Recommended size:** 320 x 320 pixels
- **Recommended aspect ratio:** 1:1
- **Display shape:** Circular crop


### Threads single image or carousel post image sizes


Because Threads is powered by Instagram, it generally supports landscape, square and vertical images in single-image posts. Vertical images take up the most screen real estate on mobile, making them the strongest choice for stopping the scroll.


**Threads single image post guidelines**


- **Square:** 1:1 ratio, 1080 x 1080 pixels
- **Vertical:** 4:5 ratio, 1440 x 1800 pixels
- **Minimum items in a carousel** : 2
- **Maximum items in a carousel:** 20 images, videos or a mix of the two.


Keep your file size under 8MB and use JPG or PNG formats for the sharpest results. Threads is built for conversation, so pair your visuals with copy that invites a response.


**Learn more about supported Threads files and sizes in our Help Center guide on[Sprout Social’s Publishing Requirements](https://support.sproutsocial.com/hc/en-us/articles/49485764377229-Image-Requirements-per-Network-with-Sprout-Publishing) .**


## Bluesky image sizes


Bluesky is a decentralized, community-first platform that’s grown since its public launch in February 2024. Data from our Q3 2025 Pulse Survey shows[51% of Bluesky users choose it over similar platforms](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/what-is-bluesky/) because they control what shows up in their feed. That curated feed puts every image under closer scrutiny, so sharp visuals belong in your[Bluesky strategy](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/bluesky-strategy/) .


Bluesky doesn’t publish official recommended pixel dimensions, so the profile and banner sizes below are Sprout Social’s recommendations. They’re based on the platform’s 1:1 avatar and 3:1 banner crops, and file limits come from Bluesky’s open-source[AT Protocol specs](https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto/tree/main/lexicons/app/bsky) .


### Bluesky profile picture size


Your profile picture appears as a circle, so keep your logo or headshot centered.


**Bluesky profile picture guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 1000 x 1000 pixels
- **Aspect ratio:** 1:1 (displays as a circle)
- **Maximum file size:** About 1 MB
- **Supported file types:** JPG or PNG


### Bluesky banner image size


Your banner stretches across the top of your profile at a wide 3:1 crop, so keep key details near the center.


**Bluesky banner guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:** 3000 x 1000 pixels
- **Aspect ratio:** 3:1
- **Maximum file size:** About 1 MB

- **Accepted file types:** JPG, static GIF or PNG

### X Standalone image ad sizes


Standalone Image Ads are standard, native-looking promoted posts that feature a single image. These ads look exactly like organic posts but include a “Promoted” label.


**X Standalone image ad guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:**


- **Square:** 1200 x 1200 pixels (1:1 aspect ratio)
- **Landscape:** 1200 x 628 pixels (1.91:1 aspect ratio)


- **Maximum file size:** 5 MB
- **Recommended file type:** PNG or JPEG (BMP and TIFF are not supported)
- **Recommended text copy:** 280 characters.


- **Note** : Every link used reduces character count by 23, so aim for 257 characters.


**Pro tip:** Square (1:1) images are highly recommended because they occupy maximum vertical screen space on mobile devices, leading to better engagement and visibility in the feed.


### X Carousel image ad sizes


Carousel Ads allow you to tell a deeper story or showcase multiple products by swiping horizontally through a series of images or videos in a single ad unit.


**X Carousel ad image guidelines**


- **Recommended image size:**


- **Landscape:** 800 x 418 pixels (1.91:1 aspect ratio)
- **Square:** 800 x 800 pixels (1:1 aspect ratio)


- **Image volume:** 2 to 6 images per carousel
- **Consistency rule:** You must use the same aspect ratio across all assets in a single carousel (you cannot mix 1:1 and 1.91:1 images).

## FAQs about social media image sizes


What image size works on every social media platform?


A 1080 x 1080 pixel square covers most feeds, and 1080 x 1920 pixels fits vertical Stories and Reels. Pinterest is the exception and prefers 1000 x 1500 pixels.


What is the best image size for an Instagram post in 2026?


Use 1080 x 1350 pixels at a 4:5 portrait ratio. The app also takes 3:4 photos, but scheduled posts must stay between 4:5 and 1.91:1.


What are the recommended image sizes for Facebook in 2026?


Use 320 x 320 pixels for your profile picture and 851 x 315 pixels for your cover photo. Feed posts work best at 1080 x 1350 pixels and Stories at 1080 x 1920 pixels.


What happens if you post an image with the wrong dimensions?


The platform crops, compresses, letterboxes or rejects it. That’s how you lose logos and text at the edges before anyone reads your post.


What file format is best for social media images?


Use JPG for photos and PNG for text-heavy graphics and logos. Keep every file under the platform’s size limit.


Is it better to use 4:3 or 16:9 for social media images?


Match the ratio to the placement. Wide formats suit banners and video thumbnails, while taller or square formats dominate mobile feeds by taking up more screen real estate. Use 16:9 for YouTube cover photos and landscape placements and 4:5 or 1:1 for Instagram and Facebook feed posts.


How often do social media image size specs change?


Constantly. Platforms update layouts, placements and ad formats without warning, which is exactly why you need a current reference guide rather than relying on memory. Bookmark this page and check back whenever a platform announces a redesign.


Can I use the same image across all social media platforms?


One image rarely fits every placement well, so resize intentionally to make your creative feel native on each platform. Use[Landscape](https://sproutsocial.com/landscape/) to resize a single asset for every platform in seconds rather than rebuilding from scratch.
